criteria.evidence: No evidence of teams willing to pay enterprise pricing ($500+/month) for this category
Depends on UNCONFIRMED hypothesis that teams would pay $50-100/month — founder believes so but has no pricing conversations
Comparable automation tools (Ramp, Brex integrations) command $30-80/month for similar time-saving features; founder's target price is in range
Teams spending 6+ hours/week at $50/hour engineer time implies $15,000+/year cost — any tool under $2,000/year is ROI-positive

assumptions_relied_on.text: Teams would pay $50-100/month for reconciliation automation
assumptions_relied_on.impact: If confirmed, Score 4 criterion would PASS, raising score from 3 to 4

key_signals: Comparable tools in $30-80/month range confirm price tolerance
ROI math strongly favors any sub-$200/month tool
No direct pricing conversations yet — founder-asserted only
analysis_narrative:
Willingness to pay is inferred rather than directly validated. The founder has not conducted pricing conversations, so the $50-100/month target is an assumption. However, the market context is supportive: Ramp and Brex integrations that save comparable time trade at $30-80/month, and the ROI math (6 hours/week × $50/hour = $15,600/year saved) makes any sub-$200/month solution a clear win on paper.

The Score 3 reflects that the pricing range is plausible and market-validated by analogues, but the UNCONFIRMED status of direct willingness-to-pay conversations leaves meaningful risk. Budget holders in finance departments often have separate approval cycles, and SaaS spend under $100/month may require a different buyer than the ops lead who feels the pain.

One confirmed pricing conversation moving the hypothesis to CONFIRMED would unlock Score 4 and add 0.12 to the weighted total.
key_finding: Willingness to pay is market-plausible but unconfirmed — comparable tools and ROI math support $50-100/month, but no direct pricing validation has occurred.
score_explanation: Score 3 reflects validated pricing analogues and strong ROI math without direct customer confirmation. Score 4 requires at least one pricing conversation confirming the $50-100/month range, which would convert the CONDITIONAL criterion to PASS.
